label: Full Filter Bar
description: Everything in one filter bar. Best for nine fields on one bar: choices with colour dots, people with an exclusive Unassigned, a nested company, a number and a flag, with the query printed as JSON.

label: Nested Attributes
description: Nested attributes at workspace scale. Best for a 2,000 attribute branch across eight record types, searched at any depth, with synonyms such as zip for postcode and type icons on the leaves.

label: Status Badges
description: Status and priority colour dots. Best for picks named on the chip until a third folds them into a count, plus a chip that takes no value.

label: Avatars & Paging
description: Options fetched as you search, and a restored view. Best for a stored query of bare ids restored by a button, with contact names fetched for ids no search has loaded yet, and a Reset.

label: Date Editors
description: A date and a date range editor. Best for today or tomorrow kept as phrases (never stale) or a day picked on a calendar, and last 7 and 30 day presets for a range.

label: Slider Editor
description: Sliders as the value editor. Best for a health score span on a two-thumb track and a monthly spend ceiling on one thumb.

label: Table Filtering
description: Filtering a table. Best for a chip bar over a staff table whose rows narrow as each chip gets a value, with a count of the rows kept.

label: Choice Controls
description: Choice controls as editors. Best for kit controls as editors: segments for a priority, radios with descriptions for a channel, toggle chips for tags and a switch for a flag.

label: Typed Inputs
description: Typed values in kit inputs. Best for a weight with its unit, pasted keywords one per line, a 6 character code in boxes and a domain checked before it is applied.

label: Popover Builder
description: Nested groups in a sheet. Best for a card whose header button opens the builder in a bottom sheet, seeded with an OR group, with short operator words such as ≥.

label: Inline Builder
description: Nested groups inline. Best for the builder on the screen, a button that drops in a saved group and a live rule count.

label: Controlled & Translated
description: Controlled, sized and translated. Best for English, German and Japanese copy over one query, a small or medium size, read-only and disabled states and a log of change reasons.
